summary: The merchant ignoring his wife occurs at 23/13
rationale: 23/12 contains only the wife saying that he cannot thwart God’s command. The following verse 23/13 begins U taǧərano lə mṣanaṭle ʕal i aṯto, bale m ṣafro azzeyo su məskeno faqirawo, exactly the quoted event and wording. The automatic found result at 23/12 is incorrect.
The supplied verse 30/136 reads kile kəmṣanəṭ, with ṭ, matching the root ṣnṭ and the listed base mṣanəṭ. The entry has plain t. The existing vowel and hyphen normalization are retained.
